{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Heavy wool blend blazer in a structured fit, navy blue (#000080), sharp lapels.
Tailored worsted wool trousers, straight-leg cut, charcoal gray (#36454F), mid-calf length.
Crisp poplin button-down shirt, classic fit, ivory white (#FFFFF0), hem tucked in.
Chelsea boots made of smooth calfskin leather, black (#000000), ankle height with a low block heel.
This outfit works perfectly for a frosty morning commute as the wool layers provide essential warmth against the snow and road salt without feeling bulky. The dark neutral palette ensures a professional appearance in the office while maintaining a neat dress code that respects her desire to avoid anything too casual or formal. The streamlined silhouette of the straight-leg trousers paired with sleek Chelsea boots allows for comfortable walking during the twenty-minute journey without compromising style."}
